title: Admin Gateways & RBAC v2: SSO Audit Trail Consolidation and Pen-Test Remediation Runbook
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Consolidate SSO/SAML admin audit trails and close pen-test findings related to RBAC v2 and admin controls. This ticket coordinates engineering remediation, adds deterministic audit paths for admin actions, ensures immutable log forwarding to our SIEM, and validates fixes through a focused threat-model re-run and internal pen-test sweep.
acceptance_criteria: All admin actions (role changes, grant/revoke, key rotations, session elevation) emit structured audit events with consistent schema
Audit events are forwarded to the SIEM (splunk://redwood-security) within 30s and indexed with retention and immutable flag set
SSO/SAML assertion logs are correlated with user-agent and IP to reconstruct admin sessions for 90 days
Pen-test findings flagged as critical/high in the last engagement are verified as mitigated by security and engineering
RBAC v2 policy evaluation path instrumented and unit-tested for edge cases (missing principals, stale roles, fallback policies)
tasks: Threat-model re-run for admin gateway flows and RBAC decision points (owner: security-research)
Define structured audit schema and event version (audit.v2) with field-level guidance (who, what, when, how, affected_principals)
Implement audit emission in admin-service and auth-gateway (server-side middleware) with sampling=0 for admin paths
Add HMAC integrity on audit batches before forwarding to SIEM; implement retry/backoff on sink failures
Extend SSO/SAML assertion logging to include assertion_id, issuer, audience, and assertion_lifetime, ensure PII redaction rules applied
Add session recording pointers for elevated sessions (link to secure blob store) and retention policy
Address pen-test items: CVE-like findings in SAML parsing, privilege escalation via policy wildcarding, missing session invalidation post-logout
Create unit and integration tests for RBAC v2 evaluation with 10+ edge scenarios and CI gating
Deploy migration to enable audit.v2 on staging, run smoke tests, then roll to canary and prod with telemetry monitoring
verification_steps: Trigger admin actions in staging and verify structured audit events contain expected fields
Validate SIEM ingestion latency and immutable flag on a sample window (10 events)
Run internal pen-test checklist and confirm remediations; security to sign off in comments
Execute RBAC evaluation unit tests in CI and ensure no regressions across matrix of roles and resources
Perform canary rollout (5% traffic) with elevated logging and monitor for error spike or increased latency
rollback_plan: If any audit forwarding regressions or RBAC evaluation failures occur in canary, disable audit.v2 feature flag, revert auth-gateway to previous tagged build, and open an incident with triage channel #sec-ops; require security sign-off before re-enabling.
